name: supercomputers
description: Refurbished HPC storefront. Three workspaces: a domain package, a NestJS API and a Next.js web tier.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @supercomputers/shared && npm run build --workspace @supercomputers/api && npm run build --workspace @supercomputers/web
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace @supercomputers/shared && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
